title: ESS-MAI Executable Prior Art v1.1.1 by Bledar Gjata — POC 003–006; Standard-Method Closure for POC 005–006
description: A public Apache-2.0 collection of four surgically bounded ESS-MAI proof-of-concept capsules. POC 005 and POC 006 now follow the explicit theory-to-source-to-runtime experimental method with frozen falsifiable claims, production caller maps, baseline, target, ablation, adversarial failure, counterexample search, repeatability, detached reproduction, machine-readable verdicts and exact claim boundaries. POC 005 establishes generation-local authority non-duplication while publishing fresh semantic reissuance and the direct-write hold as counterexamples to stronger claims. POC 006 establishes bounded verified negative-history re-entry while publishing the Boolean-only receipt and detached restart gaps. Constructive K+ and rigorous-negative K- remain distinct sibling knowledge outcomes under GCL. The publisher-timestamped 2026-06-03 ESS-MAI Negative Knowledge trace is separated from executable implementation evidence. Existing theory, ESS-MAI contribution, bounded innovation, current materialization and future research are declared separately. The full ESS-MAI v1.8.9 core is not included.
